{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates (keeping last)
data_dedup = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Convert batch-B values to ng/mL (divide by 10)
data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
data_dedup.loc[data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] /= 10

# Step 3: Compute mean of biomarker_final_ngml
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Print the number of unique patients after deduplication
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}")

# Print the mean
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
